links.outcome: Detection of confirmed bronchial foreign body aspiration cases (missed emergencies) by GPT-4.1
links.effect: Detected only 4 of 12 confirmed bronchial-aspiration cases and missed all left-bronchus aspirations; recall 19.0%, precision 23.3%, accuracy 62.3%.
links.quote: While it correctly identified 34 of 46 cases without aspiration, it detected only 4 of 12 confirmed bronchial-aspiration cases and missed all left-bronchus aspirations.

links.outcome: General-purpose multimodal model performance on real-world clinical and radiographic data for foreign body aspiration
links.effect: Accuracy 62.3%, precision 23.3%, recall 19.0%, F1-score 0.21 on real-world cases against bronchoscopy reference standard.
links.quote: The model achieved an overall accuracy of 62.3%, with precision of 23.3%, recall of 19.0%, and an F1-score of 0.21.

screen.reason: The study retrospectively evaluates the diagnostic accuracy and feasibility of a multimodal vision-enabled large language model (GPT-4.1) for detecting pediatric foreign body aspiration from clinical data and chest radiographs.
